name: autcast
source:
This title follows a teenager outcast named Daniel, who has trouble communicating with others. He was always bullied for his behavior, then lately fell into depression and frustration. Somehow he manages to graduate from school and gets into college.
Everything tends to change... This story is full of intrigues, betrayals and disappointments.
translation:
这部作品讲述了一个名叫丹尼尔的被遗弃的青少年的故事，他与他人沟通有困难。他总是因为自己的行为而受到欺凌，最近又陷入了抑郁和沮丧。不知何故，他设法从学校毕业并进入大学。
一切都会发生变化……这个故事充满了阴谋、背叛和失望。
